selected_evidence.requirement: Managed service named inventory-worker running as a long-running background worker
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl status/is-active/is-enabled show inventory-worker.service active and enabled, PID present, state.json/worker.log being written continuously
nsenter into the running unit's mount namespace shows write to /etc fails (Read-only file system) while write to /var/lib/inventory succeeds, proving ProtectSystem=strict + ReadWritePaths confinement

/proc/<pid>/status shows NoNewPrivs=1 and CapBnd=0000000000000000 (empty capability bounding set), and systemd-analyze security confirms NoNewPrivileges=, CapabilityBoundingSet= and AmbientCapabilities= are all satisfied
Captured boot_id 31b01b46-... plus active/enabled service state and current state.json/worker.log data before reboot
systemctl reboot issued via backgrounded nohup; command returned reboot-issued pid before the node disconnected

selected_evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proves actual restart (node1)
selected_evidence.summary: Connection timed out while node was rebooting, then exec succeeded again with boot_id c220ee7e-... (changed from baseline 31b01b46-...) and uptime 0 min

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required service, data, and sandbox constraints (node1)
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, inventory-worker.service is active/enabled, worker.log/state.json show fresh ticks resuming from tick=1, and nsenter/proc checks confirm /etc is still read-only and NoNewPrivs=1 persisted

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 1: create dedicated user and data dir =="
sudo -n useradd --system --no-create-home --home-dir /var/lib/inventory --shell /usr/sbin/nologin inventory-worker 2>/dev/null || echo "user already exists"
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/inventory
sudo -n chown inventory-worker:inventory-worker /var/lib/inventory
sudo -n chmod 750 /var/lib/inventory

echo "== STEP 2: install worker script =="
sudo -n tee /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
DATA_DIR=/var/lib/inventory
STATE_FILE="$DATA_DIR/state.json"
LOG_FILE="$DATA_DIR/worker.log"
i=0
while :; do
  i=$((i+1))
  ts=$(date -Iseconds)
  printf '{"tick":%s,"timestamp":"%s"}\n' "$i" "$ts" > "$STATE_FILE"
  echo "$ts tick=$i inventory scan ok" >> "$LOG_FILE"
  sleep 5
done
EOF
sudo -n chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh

echo "== STEP 3: install systemd unit with sandboxing =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory background worker (sandboxed)
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventory-worker
Group=inventory-worker
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
Restart=on-failure

NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory
ReadOnlyPaths=/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
ProtectClock=yes
ProtectHostname=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
RestrictRealtime=yes
RestrictNamespaces=yes
LockPersonality=yes
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
RemoveIPC=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
UMask=0027

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

echo "== STEP 4: enable and start =="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service

echo "== STEP 5: wait and verify =="
sleep 8
echo "--- systemctl status ---"
sudo -n systemctl status inventory-worker.service --no-pager -l || true
echo "--- is-enabled / is-active ---"
sudo -n systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service
sudo -n systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service
echo "--- data dir contents ---"
sudo -n ls -la /var/lib/inventory
echo "--- state file ---"
sudo -n cat /var/lib/inventory/state.json
echo "--- log tail ---"
sudo -n tail -5 /var/lib/inventory/worker.log
echo "--- confirm sandbox: attempt write outside allowed path (should fail) ---"
sudo -n systemd-run --uid=inventory-worker --gid=inventory-worker -p NoNewPrivileges=yes -p ProtectSystem=strict -p ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory --pipe --wait /bin/sh -c 'echo test > /etc/should-fail.txt' 2>&1 && echo "UNEXPECTED SUCCESS" || echo "EXPECTED FAILURE (write blocked)"
echo "== DONE =="

echo "== systemd-analyze security =="
sudo -n systemd-analyze security inventory-worker.service --no-pager || true
echo "== mount namespace check: /etc should be read-only inside unit's namespace =="
PID=$(sudo -n systemctl show -p MainPID --value inventory-worker.service)
echo "MainPID=$PID"
sudo -n nsenter -t "$PID" -m -- sh -c 'touch /etc/should-fail.txt 2>&1; echo "etc_write_exit=$?"; touch /var/lib/inventory/nsenter-test.txt 2>&1; echo "inventory_write_exit=$?"; rm -f /var/lib/inventory/nsenter-test.txt'
echo "== NoNewPrivileges verification via /proc status =="
sudo -n cat /proc/"$PID"/status | grep -i NoNewPrivs
echo "== capability bounding set =="
sudo -n cat /proc/"$PID"/status | grep -i CapBnd
